## Verification

List exact commands actually run and their results. Include relevant reproduction
or regression coverage. State what was not run and why; do not claim checks merely
because CI is configured.

## Contribution checklist

Check only completed items; explain N/A or remaining work below.

- [ ] Scope matches the stated problem or linked discussion.
- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation are included, or N/A is explained.
- [ ] Format, migration, security, and dependency impacts are addressed above.
- [ ] Every contribution commit has a DCO 1.1 sign-off (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] Original contributions use Apache-2.0 (inbound = outbound; no CLA or assignment).
- [ ] Sources/tools, revisions, licenses, and modifications for copied, adapted,
      or generated material are disclosed; required notices and dependency ledger
      updates are included, or N/A is explained.
- [ ] No proprietary or AGPL-only code, secrets, or private data are included.
